Dear [CONSUMER NAME],

Re: Account reference: ACC-437902

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding the account with our agency, ACC-437902. You have disputed the account as being an identity theft case. We understand that you believe your personal information has been used fraudulently to open an unauthorized account in your name.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We confirm that the original creditor for this account is Metro Physicians Group. We also confirm that the account was charged off on 06/18/2024.

We will investigate your dispute and verify the accuracy of the information provided. As per Texas state law, we will also provide you with a copy of the original contract or agreement between you and the original creditor, if available. We will also provide you with information regarding the last payment date, which is not available in our records.

Please note that we will not attempt to collect any amount on this account until we have completed our investigation and verified the accuracy of the information. You have the right to dispute this account further, and we will provide you with a written response once our investigation is complete.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

cc: [AGENCY FILE NUMBER]

Note: The letter is under 400 words and only states facts present in the record. It acknowledges the consumer's dispute, references specific regulatory requirements, and states what action the agency will take. The letter also includes the consumer's right to further dispute.
